hh_ethnologue_comment.comment: The Japonic language of Hachijō, which is not particularly closely related to the Okinawan languages and not intelligible to mainland Japanese (**hh:phonv:Iannucci:Hachijo**:101-102, **hh:h:Shimoji:Japonic**:1) is missing from E16/E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 (**hh:sd:KKK:Hachijo**).

endangerment.comment: Hachijo (10378) = Endangered (100 percent certain, based on the evidence available) (It's unknown if children are learning it. Most native speakers are middle age and older speakers.) [Dougherty 2014](cldf:dougherty:14)
